entities.name: Storgard
entities.description: A kingdom in the Sardian Mountains of Terisiare ruled by five clans, destroyed by the glaciers.

entities.name: Zilgeth
entities.description: Ruby clan leader, killed fighting a Johtull wurm.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Selected to replace Zilgeth; later ascended.

entities.name: Oriel Kjeldos
entities.description: Clan Emerald leader who suggested abandoning the city.

entities.name: Jason Carthalion
entities.description: Clan Emerald champion who won the duel against Freyalise.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Compelled Miko to arrange a duel.

entities.name: Hurn
entities.description: Led Clan Pearl and its military commander.

entities.name: Stone Council
entities.description: Council of five clans advising the king.

entities.name: Clan Pearl
entities.description: Clan that left and survived the fall.

entities.name: Fall of Storgard
entities.description: Destruction of the kingdom by the glaciers.

events.summary: Zilgeth is killed fighting a Johtull wurm around 2434 AR.
events.quote: Around 2434 AR councillor Zilgeth was killed while fighting a Johtull wurm.

events.summary: Tevesh Szat compels Miko to arrange a duel between Freyalise and Jason Carthalion, which Jason wins.
events.quote: After Jason won the duel, Freyalise ascended.

events.summary: The house of Clan Emerald is blown up and Emerald and Pearl leave the capital.
events.quote: the house of Clan Emerald was blown up in an explosion that killed sixteen

events.summary: Storgard falls to the glaciers, claiming the remaining citizens.
events.quote: The Fall of Storgard happened not long after, claiming any remaining citizens.

relations.quote: The last king before the destruction by the glaciers of Lim-Dûl and Tevesh Szat was Miko .
